description: List top-tier federal agencies with toptier codes, agency slugs, budget authority amounts, and obligation totals for the latest reported period. Returns the full directory unless limit is supplied; optional pagination slices the provider-sorted directory. Use this as the entry point for agency navigation — toptier codes and agency slugs are required inputs for usaspending_get_agency and agency-based filters on spending analysis tools.

limit.description: Agencies per page; omitted returns the full directory. No maximum.

page.description: Page number when limit is supplied (defaults to page 1); ignored without limit.

sort.description: Sort field: agency_name (alphabetical), budget_authority_amount, obligated_amount, or outlay_amount

name: usaspending_list_agencies

agency_count.description: Total number of top-tier federal agencies returned

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `api_unavailable`: USAspending.gov API is unreachable or returns an error. `api_timeout`: USAspending.gov did not respond before the request deadline elapsed. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

has_next.description: Whether another page exists; present only when limit is supplied

results.description: List of top-tier federal agencies with budget and obligation data

items.description: Agency entry with codes, slugs, and fiscal year budget data

agency_slug.description: URL-friendly agency slug (e.g., department-of-defense) — accepted by usaspending_get_agency

budget_authority_amount.description: Total budget authority amount in USD for the latest reported period

fiscal_quarter.description: Provider reporting fiscal quarter for the latest reported period

fiscal_year.description: Provider reporting fiscal year for the latest reported period

obligated_amount.description: Total obligated amount in USD for the latest reported period

outlay_amount.description: Total outlay amount in USD for the latest reported period

toptier_code.description: Three-digit toptier agency code (e.g., 097 for DoD) — required by usaspending_get_agency

total.description: Total number of agencies in the full directory before pagination

totalCount.description: Total number of agencies in the full directory before pagination

title: List Federal Agencies
